content: As a Deputy Editor of WikiDoc, I acknowledge and agree to the following standards: 1. Acknowledgement of the Audience and Responsibility for Quality I recognize that this site is accessed by millions of individuals annually. I understand that the quality of the content I contribute directly reflects my personal dedication to maintaining high standards of excellence. I acknowledge that my contributions also represent Dr. Gibson's commitment to quality. I am aware that if I fail to uphold this commitment to excellence, I may be asked to discontinue my contributions to the platform. 2. Adherence to Copyright Laws and Avoidance of Plagiarism I will not copy content from materials that are protected by copyright. I will not engage in plagiarism under any circumstances. I understand that violating copyright laws or committing plagiarism may result in my removal from the team. 3. Commitment to Excellence in Content Creation I understand that the quality of my contributions will be evaluated. I will begin sentences with capital letters and end complete sentences with appropriate punctuation. If English is not my first language, I will dedicate myself to improving my written English skills. I will adhere to the established organizational template for structuring content. I understand that careless mistakes on my part may require more effort to correct than it would take for an experienced editor to create the content from scratch. If my contributions create unnecessary work for others, I may be asked to stop contributing. I accept that it is my responsibility to conduct the necessary research to write a chapter. I will commit to learning how to perform a comprehensive literature review and how to properly cite sources. 4. Adherence to the WikiDoc Team Code of Conduct I understand that WikiDoc operates as a collaborative team, and I will treat all team members with respect. I acknowledge that if I am disrespectful to other team members, I may be asked to leave the team. I understand that any letter of recommendation I receive will reflect my commitment to being respectful and my ability to work effectively as part of a team. Signed: Dated:
